answer: An AI-agent economy can blunt Sybil attacks with per-identity staking plus random slashing audits. Each agent locks a bond for one voting right, so a Sybil farmer must post a fresh bond per forged identity; cost rises linearly with the number of fakes. At the zenith of a takeover the attacker needs capital equal to the entire honest stake. Random audits snuff the ember of any cheater by slashing that bond, while honest agents keep their yarrow stake and earn rewards. A thousand forged identities thus cost a thousand separate bonds, with no way to recycle one deposit.
